title: manageStorage
description: Backend RPC action: load or save persistent plugin data via figma.clientStorage or document pluginData. Used by figmaBridge.getClientStorage / getDocumentStorage.

params.name: params
params.description: Operation descriptor object (destructured by the handler).

operation.description: 'load' to read data, 'save' to write data.

storageKey.description: Unique key identifying the stored record.

returns.description: For load: saved object or null. For save: { ok: true }. On unknown operation: { ok: false, error }.
